question: where do i find my api key?
ground_truth:
## Where to Find Your API Key

There are **two types** of API keys, depending on what you need:

---

## 1. Integration API Key (for API Authentication)

This is the API key you use to generate Bearer tokens for API requests.

### How to Get It:
✅ **Payroc sends this to you** when you sign up  
📧 Check your welcome email or onboarding documentation

### If You Don't Have It:
Contact Payroc to retrieve or regenerate it:

**Sales Team:**  
🔗 [Partner with Payroc](https://payroc.com/contacts/partner-with-us)

**Integration Support:**  
📧 [integrationsupport@payroc.com](mailto:integrationsupport@payroc.com)

---

## 2. Payroc App API Key (for Payroc App & Cloud Simulator)

This key is used specifically with the Payroc App and the Payroc Cloud Simulator. You can manage these keys yourself in the Self-Care Portal.

---

### View an Existing Payroc App API Key

1. Sign in to the **Self-Care Portal:** [https://payments.payroc.com/merchant/selfcare](https://payments.payroc.com/merchant/selfcare)
2. On the side menu, select **Settings** → **API Keys**
3. Locate the API key you want to view (use the search function to find by Key Alias)
4. From the **Action** column, select **⋮**, then select **View Authentication Key**
5. Enter your Self-Care Portal password
6. View and copy the key

---

### Generate a New Payroc App API Key

If you don't have a Payroc App API key yet, you can create one:

1. Sign in to the **Self-Care Portal:** [https://payments.payroc.com/merchant/selfcare](https://payments.payroc.com/merchant/selfcare)
2. On the side menu, select **Settings** → **API Keys**
3. Select **NEW API KEY**
4. In **Key Alias**, enter a name for the key (e.g., "My Integration Key")
5. In **Notification Email**, enter your email address
6. In **API Permissions**, select:
   - ☑ **Account API** → Full Access
   - ☑ **Customer API** → Full Access
   - ☑ **Transaction API** → Full Access
   - ☑ **Bank Transfer API** → Full Access
   - ☑ **Reporting API** → Full Access
7. Select **SAVE**
8. Select the processing terminals the key applies to
9. Select **SAVE**
10. View and copy your new API key

---

## Quick Reference: Which Key Do I Need?

| Use Case | Key Type | Where to Find |
|----------|----------|---------------|
| Make API calls (payments, refunds, etc.) | **Integration API Key** | Sent by Payroc on signup |
| Use Payroc Cloud Simulator | **Payroc App API Key** | Self-Care Portal |
| Use Payroc App on a device | **Payroc App API Key** | Self-Care Portal |

---

## If You Don't Have Self-Care Portal Access

Contact Integration Support:  
📧 [integrationsupport@payroc.com](mailto:integrationsupport@payroc.com)

They will either:
- Provide you with access credentials
- Retrieve your API key for you
- Help set up your account

---

## Important Security Notes

⚠️ **Never share your API keys**  
⚠️ **Don't use API keys in client-side code** (browser JavaScript)  
⚠️ **Use HTTPS for all requests**  
⚠️ **Store keys securely** (environment variables, secrets manager)

---
